logger.doc:name: Start Logger
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "flowName": flow.name, "timestamp": now() >> "UTC", "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "status": "Received request to create employee records in DB" }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- payload map (item) -> { emp_id: item.empId, first_name: item.firstName, last_name: item.lastName, email_id: item.emailId, date_of_joining: item.dateOfJoining as Date {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"}, address: item.address }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "Success", message: "Employee record created successfully" }

logger.doc:name: Response Logger
logger.message:
#[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "flowName": flow.name, "timestamp": now() >> "UTC", "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "status": payload,
}]
